marta: Quick note 111 drafting a short release note + changelog entry for the new Routing Policy control-plane. Needs: 1) single-line whats-new for the feed, 2) tiny migration tip, 3) a curl + rust SDK snippet, 4) known-issue with repro and staging URL. Will open a docs PR in ~15m and request fast reviews. ping @leo @jin

leo: Nice. Call out the exact flag: routing.policy.enabled. Ops wants the fallback ordering spelled out (hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-compact). Also include canary plan: 5% for 12h, then 25% for 24h.

jin: I can do snippets. Will produce a 1-line curl for changelog and a compact Rust example for the how-to page.

harper: QA: add a Known issues bullet for the KV-cache warmup (T4), include repro command and staging preview link. I can run linkcheck after redirects.

docs-bot: PR #5233 created: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/routing-policy/preview-5233. Initial linkcheck: 1 404 (/examples/old-routing-snippet).

marta: I'll add redirect /examples/old-routing-snippet -> /docs/routing-policy/snippets and shorten the long line flagged by linter. Draft blurb below, copy-edit welcome.

marta: ```
What's new: Routing Policy (beta)
- Routing Policy lets you opt in to cost-aware routing and explicit fallback chains. Enable per route with routing.policy.enabled = true.
- Canary: 5% for 12h, then 25% for 24h before wider rollout.
Known issues:
- On some T4 hosts a transient ~5-12ms latency at seq=512 can occur while the KV cache warms. Repro: ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-policy-canary (staging). Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/routing-policy/preview-5233
Migration tip:
- If you use route-level caching, pre-warm KV or ramp traffic gradually to avoid tail latency blips.

Quick snippets:
Curl (changelog-friendly):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rodeo-3","prompt":"Write a haiku","routing":{"policy":{"enabled":true}}}'

Rust (how-to, compact):
```rust
use redwood_inference::Client;
let mut c = Client::new();
let resp = c.generate("Summarize this doc", "rodeo-3")
  .routing(json!({"policy": {"enabled": true}}))
  .send()?;
println!("{}", resp.text);
```
```

leo: Suggest change: replace 'fallback-compact' with 'fallback-compact (small variant pool)' and expand "cost-aware routing" -> "cost-aware routing with safety fallbacks".

jin: Snippets OK, I trimmed the Rust error handling to keep the example tiny. I'll add a 1-line streaming pointer for JS SDK on the how-to page.

harper: After redirect is added, I'll rerun linkcheck. Also I'll add the one-line changelog feed entry after merge: "Routing Policy (beta): opt-in routing control with fallback chains." (<=80 chars)

docs-bot: Linkcheck (preview-5233) 1: 0 404s, 0 lint errors, 1 warning (long line trimmed). Full: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/5233/linkcheck

marta: Thanks all 1 merging in ~10m. Please watch release-index render; if the changelog feed truncates the curl block weirdly, ping me and I'll adjust escaping. If we see regressions we'll revert and publish a rollback note. :rocket:
